E0354

`check(…, at: field, …)`'s `at:` doesn't name a field on the struct (D-VALIDATE1)

What

`check(…, at: field, …)`'s `at:` doesn't name a field on the struct (D-VALIDATE1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0354

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0354: tests/ui/validate_over_unknown_field.stderr.

Error [E0354]: `at: missing` doesn't name a field on this struct
  --> tests/ui/validate_over_unknown_field.jet:7:46
    |
  7 |     if Validate.over(signup).check(true, at: missing, "missing").finish() == {
    |                                              ^^^^^^^
 Why: D-VALIDATE1: `check(…, at: field, …)`'s `at:` argument must be a bare field name declared on the same struct — it's how the reported `FieldError.path` is chosen
 Fix: fix the field name, or add the field to the struct
